description: Free pre-payment policy decision. Agents ask whether an x402 endpoint should be paid under strict, standard, or permissive policy. The free result is sufficient by default; set require_audit_receipt only when a settlement-backed receipt is required.

agent_policy.description: Readiness policy to apply. Use strict unless the operator explicitly permits a different policy.

endpoint.description: Public x402 endpoint to evaluate before payment; never include credentials or private query parameters.

max_usdc.description: Caller-approved per-call spending ceiling in decimal USDC, for example 0.01. This check never spends funds.

require_audit_receipt.description: Explicitly request the optional paid receipt handoff after an allow decision. This does not submit payment.

title: Agent Payment Preflight
